items.stem: An AI recommends a dynamic price change. What should the retailer check before applying it broadly?

options.text: The assumptions behind it and any unfair or harmful impact on customers
options.rationale: Correct: pricing models can rely on flawed assumptions or create unfair outcomes.

options.text: Nothing; AI prices are always optimal
options.rationale: AI prices can be wrong or unfair.

options.text: Only whether it increases short-term revenue
options.rationale: Short-term revenue ignores fairness and trust risks.
Competitor impression is irrelevant to the decision.

items.stem: Which TWO practices support responsible AI use in e-commerce? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Use customer data within consent and privacy rules
options.rationale: Correct: lawful, consented data use protects customers and the business.

options.text: Check segmentation and pricing models for unfair bias
options.rationale: Correct: bias review protects fairness and trust.

options.text: Reuse personal data for any new purpose without notice
options.rationale: Unnotified reuse breaches privacy expectations and rules.

options.text: Hide from customers that decisions are automated
options.rationale: Concealing automation undermines transparency and trust.

items.explanation: Correct: lawful, consented data use protects customers and the business.

items.stem: Why should an AI customer-service chatbot include a path to a human agent?

options.text: AI can fail or mishandle complex or sensitive cases that need a person
options.rationale: Correct: escalation protects customers when AI is out of its depth.
Chatbots struggle with complex or sensitive cases.
